approach: Official product images copied without AI editing. Generated landscape is illustrative, not a photograph of a real deployment. Device display does not assert system integration or certification. Dock 3 compatible aircraft are 4D/4TD; M4T displayed independently.

forest-background.png.prompt: Photorealistic overcast forested mountains in central China. Restrained green and slate palette. No aircraft, buildings, people, logos, text, fire or neon. Official aircraft overlaid separately in application.

fire-response-scene.png.source: Built-in imagegen, generated composite using the four official product references listed above. Not an official DJI scene photograph.
fire-response-scene.png.scene: Forest fire discovery, aerial transport of firefighting supplies and water containers, ground hose suppression. Illustrative, does not verify equipment integration or operational capabilities.

fire-response-panorama.png.source: Built-in imagegen. Photographic composite, NOT actual incident footage or an official DJI firefighting demonstration.
fire-response-panorama.png.changes: No people; long single central hoist line to hook, short cargo bridle below hook; supplied red cylinder with water release; deep wildfire terrain; foreground suppression, midground supply transport, distant reconnaissance.
fire-response-panorama.png.limitations: Illustrative payload, perspective and action; no claim of certified bucket compatibility or exact engineering geometry.

m4td-official-reference.png.usage: Reference for the airborne M4TD only; the ground Dock enclosure is omitted from the composite.
